adaptation.rule: Landscape screenshots default to 1440px PC layout width unless the user specifies another width.

strategy: Rendered a dedicated Bizwise customer profile page from page-local design-token and UI-DSL artifacts.
Ignored the gray presentation canvas, outer rounded showcase frame, and showcase drop shadow; the inner application shell is the rendered root.
Used normalized desktop proportions for the 236px sidebar, 321px customer profile column, 105px page header, 57px tab row, and activity cards.
Regenerated the tabbar under the updated skill rules as edge-spread, content-sized tabs instead of equal tracks or space-around outer gutters.
Regenerated boundary ownership under the updated skill rules: the sidebar is borderless and the visible vertical line is owned by the adjacent workspace/profile edge.
Regenerated the main-stage shell under the updated per-corner radius rules: the top-left corner is rounded and the other shell corners remain square.
Used local SVG/CSS approximations for icons, the bizwise brand mark, and the customer avatar because no source icon/avatar assets were available.
Rendered repeated navigation items, profile details, tags, and event cards from data arrays to keep the React implementation maintainable.
Applied the updated shell-offset rule: the right product stage is an outer clipped shell with a visible top offset, top/left border, and xs top-left directional edge shadow.
Moved vertical scrolling to an inner main-stage pane so the sticky opaque page header can prevent content bleed without removing the outer shell top offset.
Kept most UI surfaces flat with borders and dividers. Only event cards and the filtered button use a very subtle shadow visible in the screenshot.

desktop.main: outer shell no longer owns vertical scrolling; inner pane owns lg/main-stage scrolling
desktop.topbar: sticky top-0 z-40 solid white page header inside the inner scroll pane
desktop.main_shell: inner clipped stage shell: lg:h-full overflow-hidden rounded-tl-[8px] border-l border-t xs top-left shadow

Source inspection confirmed the sidebar no longer renders its own right border; the adjacent workspace/profile edge owns the visible boundary.
Source inspection confirmed data-scroll-container=main-stage-inner owns lg:overflow-y-auto and the outer main shell owns rounded-tl clipping.

commands.notes: All page-local JSON artifacts parse successfully.
Confirmed the regenerated page/artifacts include painted external main-stage shell offset, inner scroll-container ownership, and xs directional shell-edge shadow.
Confirmed the regenerated page/artifacts include borderless sidebar ownership and asymmetric top-left shell radius.

commands.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const jsx=fs.readFileSync('src/pages/bizwise-profile/BizwiseProfilePage.jsx','utf8'); const asideStart=jsx.indexOf('<aside'); const aside=jsx.slice(asideStart, jsx.indexOf('>', asideStart)); const mainStart=jsx.indexOf('<main'); const main=jsx.slice(mainStart, jsx.indexOf('>', mainStart)); if (aside.includes('border-r')) throw new Error('sidebar aside still has border-r'); if (!main.includes('rounded-tl-[8px]')) throw new Error('main stage missing rounded-tl-[8px]'); const dsl=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/pages/bizwise-profile/artifacts/ui-dsl.json','utf8')); const root=dsl.root.children[0]; const sidebar=root.children.find(n=>n.id==='sidebar'); const stage=root.children.find(n=>n.id==='profile_workspace'); if (sidebar.appearance.border.visible !== false) throw new Error('sidebar DSL border is not false'); if (stage.appearance.radius.role !== 'asymmetric' || stage.appearance.radius.top_left !== 8 || stage.appearance.radius.top_right !== 0) throw new Error('stage DSL asymmetric radius missing'); console.log('ok')"
commands.notes: Confirmed no sidebar right border remains on the aside, the main shell renders rounded-tl-[8px], and the UI DSL records borderless sidebar plus asymmetric top-left shell radius.
No old broad shell-edge shadow or sm shell-edge shadow remains in the implementation, DSL, or token artifact.

browser_checks.notes: Final page was inspected after closing DevTools. The main-stage top offset is visible on a pale app-canvas background, not a black/transparent gap. The stage keeps top/left border treatment, the sidebar is borderless, the shell top-left corner is rounded, and the shell shadow is tight/subtle rather than broad.

DOM shows root bg-[#f7f9fc], app-canvas wrapper data-shell-offset-canvas=main-stage with lg:pt-[12px], main shell data-shell-radius=top-left, and inner main-stage scroll container. Visible text includes Customer Profile, tab labels, Filtered 3, and all event titles.

limitations: Browser console was not deeply audited; validation focused on build success, JSON validity, DOM structure, and visual shell-offset/shadow checks in Chrome.
